description: OpenClaw 2026.11.5 in --local mode with its diagnostics-otel plugin: one read of hello.txt, then the answer; traces with content.
notes: The plugin is installed from npm into the staged home (IN7.0), so the exporter capability is granted; the case uses the --local run, not the gateway. openclaw.model.usage is a per-turn total of the model calls and is dropped by cetra. openclaw.context.assembled is dropped too. OpenClaw puts the run's date into the user message and a timestamp and idempotency key into openclaw.content.input_messages, and the output message list carries the provider's response fields; these values differ between runs, so the five attributes are timing attributes: the check ignores their values and they are not rewritten. openclaw.model_call.time_to_first_byte_ms is measured. The tool-call id is the mock's and stable, so nothing is volatile.
